decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.
<p>Only the proposed 3 of ventilation units - Wall Kit Model CD12, 47dBLAeq noise output, shall be installed and put to use.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>
<p>The recommendations of the Jonathan Mape Noise Impact Assessment report, dated 1 may 2026 shall apply.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>A post installation noise assessment report that demonstrates the noise levels from the Wall Kit Model CD12 unit when running simultaneously shall be 10dB(A) or more below the background noise level when measured at 1m from any nearby noise sensitive premises at any time.</p><p>The assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval.</p><p>The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>

<p>Prior to the installation of the ventilation grilles hereby approved, details or manufacturer's specifications of the matte light gold finish shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>If a suitable matte light gold match cannot be sourced, specifications for an alternative anthracite grey finish shall be submitted for approval. </p><p>The development shall be implemented strictly in accordance with the approved details and retained as such thereafter.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To safeguard the visual amenities of the host building and the surrounding area.</p>
description: Installation of two ventilation grilles to facilitate a reversible mechanical fan system on the southern and western elevations.
